description: NaBa₄Ge₃S₁₀Cl crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded to three equivalent S and two equivalent Cl atoms to form NaS₃Cl₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent GeS₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NaS₃Cl₂ trigonal bipyramids. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.84 Å. There is one shorter (3.05 Å) and one longer (3.12 Å) Na-Cl bond length. There are two inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven S and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Ba-S bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.69 Å. The Ba-Cl bond length is 3.16 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven S atoms. There are a spread of Ba-S bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.29 Å. Ge is bonded to four S atoms to form GeS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent GeS₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaS₃Cl₂ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ge-S bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.30 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four Ba atoms to form SBa₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent SBa₃NaGe trigonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent ClBa₃Na₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three equivalent SBa₃NaGe trigonal bipyramids. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ba and two equivalent Ge atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Ba and one Ge atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to one Na, three Ba, and one Ge atom to form distorted SBa₃NaGe trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SBa₄ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent SBa₃NaGe trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one SBa₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent ClBa₃Na₂ trigonal bipyramids. Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and three equivalent Ba atoms to form ClBa₃Na₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent SBa₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ClBa₃Na₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with six equivalent SBa₃NaGe trigonal bipyramids.
